definitions.gloss: discretion; good judgment; discernment; common sense
definitions.explanation: The ability to make sound, mature judgments about right and wrong or appropriate behavior. Implies wisdom that comes with experience and maturity.

notes:
Read as ふんべつ, this word means discretion or good judgment. Note the different reading {分別|ぶんべつ} (sorting, separation — e.g., garbage sorting), which is a separate word with an existing entry.

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading is critical here:
- ふんべつ = discretion, good judgment (this entry)
- ぶんべつ = sorting, separation (see separate entry)

USAGE:
Often used in the patterns {分別|ふんべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (having discretion) and {分別|ふんべつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく (to gain judgment/maturity). The word has a slightly old-fashioned, moral tone and is often used when admonishing someone to behave more maturely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分別|ふんべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — having discretion/good sense
- {分別|ふんべつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく — to gain judgment, to become mature enough to know better
- {分別|ふんべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦わきまえる→わきまえる：15928_wakimaeru⟧ — to know good judgment
- {分別|ふんべつ}{盛|ざか}り — at the age of discretion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{判断力|はんだんりょく}→判断力：17617_handanryoku⟧ — judgment, ability to judge (more neutral)
- ⟦{良識|りょうしき}→良識：16057_ryoushiki⟧ — good sense, common sense (more formal)
- ⟦{思慮|しりょ}→思慮：25316_shiryo⟧ — deliberation, prudence (more literary)
